pairs.subject: model-composed-workspace
pairs.evidence: src/features/home/sub_cockpit/widgets/TimelineWidget.tsx:82 The timeline widget renders events (labels, details such as 'exit 1 after 42s', timestamps) that Athena wrote into compose_cockpit config, rather than data a module view fetched itself, so model-authored figures appear in the composed region with the authority of a report.

techniques.evidence: src/features/home/sub_cockpit/widgets/TimelineWidget.tsx:82 Several kinds (timeline, comparison_cards, verdict, stat_grid) take their data from model config, and nothing in the widgets refuses figures in model text. Other kinds do own their numbers with real error states (RecentDecisionsWidget.tsx:85 `error={error ? {`, and LinkedMemories/TemplateSuggestions likewise), so this is mixed. The rule is still broken for the config-fed kinds.

pairs.registryProposal: composition-region assumes every placed unit is a module view that fetches its own data. Personas also has explanation kinds (verdict, comparison_cards, timeline) whose whole content is the model's own reasoning. The standard could say whether such 'model-content cards' are allowed in the region at all, or must live in the transcript under a provenance label.
